title: Assessment Design in the GenAI Era: The X1-X2-X3 Assessment Pattern for Testing Students' AI Literacy, Learning Outcomes, and Reflection
abstract: arXiv:2608.12351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has challenged the validity of unsupervised online assessment, especially in technical subjects where plausible answers can be produced with little effort. This paper reports lessons from designing and implementing an AI-aware, AI-testing assessment in a large second-year undergraduate database systems module. The design combined two linked elements: (1) a structured three-part response format (X1-X2-X3) in which students documented a sourced answer, produced their own answer, and evaluated the sourced output; and (2) an AI-aware question-design process in which draft tasks were stress-tested against contemporary GenAI tools and revised when generic prompting produced superficially adequate answers. translated_title: GenAI时代下的评估设计：用于测试学生AI素养、学习成果与反思的X1-X2-X3评估模式
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）对无监督在线评估的有效性提出了挑战，尤其是在技术类课程中，学生可以轻松生成看似合理的答案。本文报告了在一个大型二年级本科数据库系统模块中设计和实施一种AI感知、AI测试型评估的经验。该设计结合了两个关联要素：（1）一种结构化的三部分响应格式（X1-X2-X3），要求学生记录有出处的答案、撰写自己的答案，并评估有出处的输出；（2）一种AI感知的题目设计过程，在此过程中，草拟的任务会针对当代GenAI工具进行压力测试，并在通用提示产生表面合格的答案时进行修订。该报告基于存档的评估材料、评分标准、规划记录、设计阶段的GenAI试验、练习响应数据、成绩记录和外部评审意见。其主要贡献在于提出了一种可复制的评估模式，以在GenAI时代保持学术诚信并促进深度学习。
tldr: 本文提出了一种X1-X2-X3评估模式，通过结合有出处答案、自主答案和批判性评估三个环节，并辅以AI压力测试的题目设计，来有效应对GenAI对在线评估的挑战，同时培养学生的AI素养和反思能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an X1-X2-X3 assessment pattern that combines sourced answers, self-generated answers, and critical evaluation, along with AI stress-tested question design, to address GenAI challenges in online assessment while fostering students' AI literacy and reflection.
